core_question: whether a learned one-shot candidate-specific remote intervention has positive incremental value over continuing from the exact same finite-beam state under the same preregistered remaining graph-NDC cap

positive: E13 early L10 trace improves detection of queries with reroute headroom
E15 full finite-beam trace has incremental predictive information over a fitted geometry model
E15 cost-constrained finite-candidate oracle has positive utility intervals
negative: E14 final v4 paid-trace frontier-topology chooser strongly loses Recall and adds NDC on WebVid; the final Yandex extension was not run
E16 query-only local utility Atlas has intervals crossing zero at all four dataset-by-L points
unmeasured: checkpoint-prefix state incremental value over query-only
in-place state reuse value over restart-and-merge

novelty_position.defensible_unit: paired same-state candidate-specific continue-versus-force-expand action value with abstention under one preregistered residual graph-NDC cap, per-branch actual NDC accounting, and a frozen NSG kernel

proposed_first_protocol.start_policy: one frozen paired Fast3 build, subject to protocol approval
proposed_first_protocol.primary_eligibility: candidate entry is not visited at checkpoint
proposed_first_protocol.mechanism_control: natural pool insertion without forced expansion
proposed_first_protocol.remaining_work: same preregistered additional graph-distance-evaluation cap B for every branch
proposed_first_protocol.pool_capacity: L remains pool capacity and is not a work budget
proposed_first_protocol.early_finished_queries: included in unconditional mean with zero intervention gain

required_state: base graph metric kernel and query identity
L K and initial entry identities
ordered retset including id distance and pending flag
neighbor offset and scheduler update state if a cap cuts an expansion
bounded GT-free online history used by the controller

ab_linkage.natural_interface: frozen deployed AB supplies the time-zero entry and a fixed-work deduplicated shortlist; C acts only after the checkpoint
ab_linkage.reason: the initial policy changes the distribution of visited pool frontier and intervention values
ab_linkage.required_factorial: paired Fast versus frozen deployed AB crossed with no intervention versus policy-specific C
ab_linkage.synergy_claim: requires preregistered positive interaction plus AB+C superiority; a best but additive pipeline is not called synergy
